content: Hello! If you need any help confirming your tuition payment or need a breakdown for the semester, just let me know. The finance office is processing submissions until 3 PM Friday for end-of-month clearances.

Great, I paid the spring tuition yesterday through PayPal using the school account finance@clearviewacademy.org. The payment was $1,320, and I used my son Oliver Chen's student ID, 4307852, in the memo.

Thank you, I see $1,320 received on our PayPal account under Oliver Chen, student ID 4307852, your unique transaction reference is PP-772191. Since you sent it before the 3 PM cut-off, it will be cleared with this cycle.
Perfect, I was worried about missing the deadline. Should I expect any confirmation soon?
Yes, a confirmation email will be sent to chen.family@mail.com by tomorrow noon at the latest. If you don't receive it, just reference PP-772191 when reaching out for updates.
Thanks! Will the payment show up on the parent portal too?

Absolutely. Within 24 hours, the $1,320 payment under Oliver Chen will appear in your portal's Financials tab, tied to your registered phone number, 646-555-0198. If you don't see it by then, it might be due to system refresh delays.
That's reassuring. I'll check tomorrow morning and keep that reference handy.
Great plan! Keeping PP-772191 and Oliver's student ID 4307852 on hand speeds up any resolution if needed. Let us know if anything looks off before Friday's 3 PM processing window closes.
